page.layout: One page of index in three columns, with a heading "INDEX" at the top; the left column holds the Gregorius and Hadrianus entries, the middle column the Innocentius and Ioannes entries, and the left-hand block continues below with Hadrianus, Higinus, Hilarius, Honorius and Hormisda. Page number at the foot below the columns.
page.notes: The right column ends at the bottom edge and is partly cut off; the last entries (Ioannes decimusquintus onward, and the catchword "Ioan..." at the foot) are only partly legible and not read with certainty. The "Gregorius undecimus 375" and "Gregorius duodecimus 393" lines wrap with the page number on a separate line. Where a number was not legible, the line was not reconstructed and this is marked here rather than guessed. Several line ends are faint or smudged; the printed readings for Innocentius secundus (230), Ioannes octauus (115) and Ioannes undecimus (132) are uncertain. The Hadrianus/Honorius block in the left column is reproduced as printed; some page numbers may be misread. Show-through from the reverse side is present but was not transcribed.
